name: DOJ SLS status reconciliation queue
nonclaim: A reconciliation ticket is a work item triggered by source conflict, lag, or incomplete current-status evidence. It is not a current-status assertion.

tickets.conflict_summary: DOJ cases page, updated May 1, 2026, lists NOPD as Enforcement; a DOJ press release says a federal court terminated the decree on November 19, 2025.
tickets.public_display_rule: Display only as unresolved source-status conflict; do not choose Enforcement or Closed/Terminated as cube current status.
tickets.next_action: Accession terminal order/docket entry and compare with DOJ cases page, monitor archive, and city consent-decree page.

tickets.public_display_rule: Display only as unresolved source-status conflict; do not choose Enforcement or Closed/Terminated as cube current status.

tickets.conflict_summary: DOJ press release says a joint motion to terminate was filed; the cases page remains Enforcement. Motion is not equivalent to termination.

tickets.next_action: Find court docket/order after February 19, 2026; reconcile with independent monitor site.

tickets.matter_label: Orange County District Attorney's Office and Orange County Sheriff's Department
tickets.conflict_summary: The DOJ cases row carries mixed OCDA/OCSD statuses; a later DOJ press release says OCDA completed an agreement. This demands child agency-status objects.
tickets.public_display_rule: Display only the mixed-source warning until OCDA and OCSD child status objects are modeled.
tickets.next_action: Build agency_status_child schema and split OCDA agreement from OCSD validation/compliance surfaces.

tickets.matter_label: Louisville Metro Police Department / Minneapolis Police Department
tickets.conflict_summary: DOJ closure/retraction language must be recorded without erasing the source history of findings reports, complaints, consent decrees, fact sheets, motions, and orders.
tickets.public_display_rule: Display federal closure/retraction only as a dated DOJ event; preserve earlier public-record carriers as historical source rows.
tickets.next_action: Model history-retention warning and distinguish federal posture from state/local reform agreements.

tickets.conflict_summary: DOJ cases page and DOJ press release broadly align, but the cube has not accessioned the court order/docket state.
tickets.public_display_rule: May show aligned source signals, still not a cube current-status assertion until terminal order is frozen.
tickets.next_action: Accession final dismissal/order and map remaining local accountability surfaces, if any.
